label: City of Paragould government
discovery: Official city website, clerk, council, finance, procurement, boards, permits, and public notices

label: Greene County government
discovery: Official county website, Quorum Court, clerk, assessor, treasurer, budgets, bids, and notices
access_note: robots.txt requests Crawl-Delay 10; the collector now honors it.

label: Greene County Sheriff
discovery: Official policies, releases, jail information, public logs, and complaint process
request_route: Sheriff records custodian; counsel if the agency is subject

label: Paragould Police Department
discovery: Official policies, releases, complaint process, and records information
request_route: Police records custodian; counsel if the agency is subject

label: Arkansas Secretary of State business records
discovery: Entity formation, officers, agents, amendments, assumed names, and status
access_note: Automated requests return HTTP 403 (checked 2026-11-05). Do not automate or evade; search by hand and save the page, or request records.

label: Arkansas CourtConnect
discovery: Case metadata, docket events, permitted filings, orders, judgments, and appeals
request_route: Court clerk process; counsel for restricted or sealed records
access_note: Site disclaimer says the data is informational, not an official record, and restricts commercial and bulk use. Look up cases by hand; confirm with the clerk.

label: Arkansas ethics and campaign records
discovery: Campaign finance, disclosures, committees, lobbying, and ethics information
request_route: Applicable state ethics or election records custodian
access_note: robots.txt allows general crawling (checked 2026-11-05) but filings are served by search forms; save result pages by hand or collect specific page URLs.

label: Arkansas audit and oversight records
discovery: Audits, compliance findings, legislative oversight, licensing, and accreditation
request_route: Issuing oversight body or records custodian

label: Arkansas state financial transparency portal
discovery: State vendor payments, contracts, and agency spending published by the state
request_route: Department of Finance and Administration records custodian
access_note: robots.txt disallows /search.php and /ajax.php (checked 2026-11-05); do not automate those. Use the site's own export or download features by hand.

label: Arkansas Attorney General
discovery: Published FOIA opinions, consumer and public-integrity notices

label: Arkansas General Assembly
discovery: Bills, acts, committee meetings, and legislator information published by the legislature

label: Arkansas Department of Finance and Administration
discovery: State budget, procurement, and revenue publications

label: Arkansas Judiciary administration
discovery: Published court rules, administrative orders, and judicial reports (not case files)

label: USAspending federal awards API
discovery: Federal contracts, grants and payments with Greene County, AR as place of performance
legal_basis: Public Treasury open-data API, no login or key

label: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer API
discovery: IRS Form 990 data for Paragould-area nonprofits: revenue, expenses, officer pay
legal_basis: Republishes public IRS data; attribute ProPublica when quoting

label: FEC campaign-finance API
discovery: Federal campaign contributions from Paragould, AR donors
legal_basis: Public FEC API; set FEC_API_KEY (free from api.data.gov)

label: Arkansas State Archives Digital Archives
discovery: Searches public CONTENTdm collections, including newspapers, government and county records, manuscripts, maps, images, and ephemera
request_route: Arkansas State Archives research and reproduction request process
legal_basis: Public Arkansas State Archives CONTENTdm API and catalog text
coverage_limit: Only indexed, digitized records in the public Digital Archives; separate library/microfilm catalogs and non-digitized records are not searched

label: Library of Congress Chronicling America
discovery: Full-text search of digitized U.S. newspaper pages and OCR, including mentions of Arkansas places and people
legal_basis: Public Library of Congress JSON API and digitized newspaper OCR
coverage_limit: Searches digitized titles across the U.S.; not all newspapers or archival collections, and results may mention places outside Arkansas

label: Public social and video sources
discovery: Individually selected public posts, official accounts, public comments, and public videos
request_route: Platform reporting or records process only where applicable

label: Federal agency records
discovery: Agency reading rooms, inspector general reports, grants, contracts, and enforcement releases

label: Medical and child-welfare material
discovery: Public policies, aggregate reports, audits, and authorized records only
request_route: Counsel, authorized custodian, or formal legal process

label: Arkansas Commission on Law Enforcement Standards and Training (CLEST)
discovery: Officer certification standards, commission meeting agendas/minutes and published rules
request_route: CLEST records custodian under the Arkansas FOIA; certification/discipline status requests
